description: Authored development benchmark, frozen before the changes in this checkpoint; not an independently held-out sample or a semantic-grounding test.

records.body: The spare keys are inside the blue ceramic bowl beside the door.
Orchid project budget is 2400 pounds. Noor approves purchases.
Violet delivery arrives on 2027-02-03 with 19 sample trays.
Nightly backups go to the external Cedar drive; encryption is enabled.
Ernos compiles a source by running ernos filename.ep. It produces an executable beside the source.
The design review meeting is on Thursday at 14:30 with Priya.
Our cat Juniper eats salmon kibble and dislikes chicken.
I prefer decaffeinated coffee after midday.
Tomato seedlings need watering every second morning.
Invoice INV-731 belongs to Larch Studio and is due March 12.
The dashboard accent colour is amber, hex FFBE33.
The sensor calibration notebook is in drawer four of the workshop.
Mina maintains the telemetry service. Pavel handles deployments.
For the Oslo trip, the train leaves platform six at 08:15.
The next reading group book is The Dispossessed by Ursula Le Guin.
A guest named Elliot cannot eat peanuts.
Credentials are stored in the system keychain; never put them in log files.
To restore a snapshot, first validate its manifest and checksum.
Zoë manages the Zürich archive; preserve both spellings.
The borrowed microscope must be returned to Saira before Friday.
The incubator target temperature is 37 degrees Celsius.
Accounts are managed by Noor using a monthly ledger.
The domain renewal deadline is April 18.
The terracotta reservoir holds nine litres of rainwater.
